user.title: Sign in to Keurig
user.description:
1. [Sign in to Keurig]({url}) in a browser with developer tools open (Network tab, *Preserve log* on).
2. After signing in, find the request to the redirect address that contains `?code=` and copy its full URL.
3. Paste it below within about a minute — codes are single-use and expire quickly.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Keurig again
